artifact: ETH 15m V15E multi-speed trend ensemble preregistration
owner_approval: 2026-08-21 conversation: after receiving the industry/GitHub review and proposed V12F -> multi-speed EWMAC/Donchian -> six-MA soft score design, owner explicitly replied '去实现吧'. This authorizes this composite research experiment. It does not authorize holdout reuse, barrier changes, model training, promotion, deployment or live trading.
question: Can a causal multi-speed trend ensemble rank/filter V12F ETH 15m candidates better without repeating the V13 hard-density-gate failure?
exposure_warning: All repository pre-holdout periods have already been viewed by the analyst in predecessor studies. This experiment is mechanism research and robustness evidence, not unseen OOS or confirmation-grade evidence.

single_composite_variable.baseline: frozen V12F full-state MA6-W8 candidate stream
single_composite_variable.candidate: V15E V12F candidates filtered by one continuous trend-quality threshold
unchanged: EMA100 regime and EMA200 slope-12 direction
ATR14 x4 initial stop capped at 3 percent
1.5 percent break-even trigger and 0.1 percent offset
1 percent risk sizing and 13x leverage cap
calendar filters, cooldown, reversal semantics and 20bp cost

feature_contract.donchian_formula: clip((close[t] - midpoint(prior highest high, prior lowest low)) / prior half-range, -1, 1)
feature_contract.trend_forecast: equal-weight mean of the three EWMAC and three Donchian forecasts
feature_contract.dense_soft_feature: existing causal dense_start_score for the candidate side; never a standalone boolean gate
feature_contract.feature_visibility: every value at decision bar t uses bars <= t; entry remains open[t+1]
feature_contract.external_code_policy: formula independently implemented; no GPL source copied

ranking: maximize the worse 2023 half-year matched-control excess bp per trade
then maximize the worse 2023 half-year project-net bp per trade
then maximize the worse 2023 half-year compounded return
selection_contract.fail_closed: if no profile has at least 10 trades in each 2023 half, select no V15 profile

locked_evaluation_order: evaluate the locked threshold on 2024H1/2024H2 and calendar 2024
only then describe the already-consumed final-preholdout 2025-01 through 2026-02 segment

acceptance.economic_gate: selected V15 must have positive matched-control excess in every primary period and positive composite top-decile net return with permutation p < 0.01; otherwise rejected/paper-only
mechanism_checks: does not reduce the count of V12F gross >=10 percent runners by more than half in any primary period
early-stop rate does not worsen in every primary period
drawdown does not worsen in every primary period
regardless_of_result: official TradingView trade-export parity remains required
